lookingFor.title: What are you looking for on Sohby?
lookingFor.subtitle: You can pick more than one. We use it to highlight people who suit you.
lookingFor.flirtNote: If you pick Dating, only people who picked it too will see it. People not looking for dating can't message you for that.

dating.title: Your dating preferences
dating.subtitle: This is only used to find matches and is never shown on your profile.
dating.interestLabel: Who would you like to meet?
dating.consentText: I give my explicit consent for Sohby to process my dating preference and the gender(s) I'm interested in, solely to show me suitable people. I can withdraw this consent at any time by removing the Dating option.

basics.title: How should we know you?
basics.subtitle: Your display name appears on your profile and in messages.
basics.birthDateHint: Sohby is for people aged 18 and over. Your date of birth is never shown and can't be changed later.

location.title: Where do you live?
location.subtitle: We use your city to find people nearby. We never ask for or share your exact location.
location.districtHint: Optional. You can choose whether it's shown in the last step.

hobbies.title: What do you enjoy?
hobbies.subtitle: Pick 1 to 15 hobbies. We'll highlight people who share them.

about.title: Tell us a bit about yourself
about.subtitle: A few lines are enough. You decide how much to share.
about.bioPlaceholder: Cinema on weekends, chess on weekdays. I love having coffee with new people.

privacy.title: What should your profile show?
privacy.subtitle: Anything you turn off is hidden from others. You can change these any time in Settings.
privacy.showInDiscoverHint: If off, only people you message can see you.
privacy.showDistrictHint: If off, only your city is shown.
privacy.showGenderHint: If off, your gender isn't shown on your profile.
privacy.showOnlineHint: Others can see when you're online.

policy.everyoneHint: Anyone on Sohby can message you directly.
policy.request_firstHint: First messages arrive as requests; the chat opens when you accept.
policy.common_hobby: Only people with a shared hobby
policy.common_hobbyHint: You must share at least one hobby; these also arrive as requests.

requests.intro: First messages from people you haven't talked to wait here. No chat opens until you accept.
requests.empty: You have no pending message requests.

safety.blockBody: They won't be able to message you or send requests, and won't see you in Explore or on your profile. Your chat will be hidden for both of you. They won't be notified.
safety.reportIntro: Reports are confidential; {name} won't know who reported them.
safety.notePlaceholder: Briefly describe what happened. It helps our review.
safety.alsoBlockHint: They won't be able to message you or see you again.

3.body: Find people nearby or with shared hobbies, and send a message.

adult.title: 18+ only
adult.body: We ask for your date of birth at sign-up; under-18s can't register.

private.title: Private messages
private.body: Only the two people in a chat can see it.

safety.title: Block and report
safety.body: Keep anyone who bothers you away with one tap.

settings.title: Settings
settings.messagesHint: Tighten this if unexpected messages bother you.
settings.visibleHint: Anything you turn off is hidden from others.
settings.showInDiscoverHint: If off, only people you message can see you.
settings.showDistrictHint: If off, only your city is shown.
settings.showGenderHint: If off, your gender isn't shown on your profile.
settings.showOnlineHint: Others can see when you're online.
settings.showReadReceiptsHint: Others see when you've read their message. If off, you can't see theirs either.
settings.acceptAnonymousHint: Anonymous messages always arrive as requests; no chat opens until you accept.
settings.languageHint: Menus, notifications and emails use this language. Messages aren't translated.
settings.saveError: Couldn't save your settings. Please try again.
settings.blockedHint: If you unblock someone, they can message and see you again.
settings.deleteHint: Your account closes immediately and nobody can see you. Your messages are kept for 90 days for report reviews, then permanently deleted.
settings.deleteConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This can't be undone. Your account closes immediately and you'll be signed out.
settings.deleteError: Couldn't delete the account. Please try again.
settings.flirtOnHint: Dating is on. Only mutual matches can see this. Your preference is never shown to anyone, and nobody (including you) can read it back.
settings.flirtOffHint: Dating is off. If you turn it on, only mutual matches will see it.
settings.flirtInterest: Who would you like to meet?
settings.flirtConsent: I give my explicit consent for my dating preference and the gender(s) I'm interested in to be processed solely to show me suitable people. I can withdraw this consent here at any time.
settings.flirtDisable: Turn off dating and withdraw consent
settings.flirtNeedInterest: Choose who you'd like to meet.
settings.flirtNeedConsent: You need to give explicit consent to use dating.
settings.flirtDisabled: Dating turned off; your preference was deleted.
settings.flirtError: Couldn't complete the action. Please try again.
settings.declinedHint: People you decline aren't told, and they can't send you another request. If you change your mind, undo the decline and the request goes back to Requests. You can also message them yourself.
settings.undoDeclineError: Couldn't undo the decline. Please try again.
settings.photosHint: Photos always arrive blurred and stay hidden until you open them.

anon.composeNote: Your identity stays hidden; {name} only sees a random nickname. Your message arrives as a request. Blocking and reporting still apply to your real account.
anon.sentBody: Your nickname: {alias}. The chat opens if they accept.
anon.waiting: Your request is pending. You can't send another message until it's accepted.
anon.incomingNote: You don't know who sent it, and they can't continue unless you accept. If you block or report, it applies to their real account.
anon.revealRequested: You asked them to reveal their identity.
anon.revealAsked: They would like you to reveal your identity.
anon.revealConfirmBody: They'll see your real profile and the chat becomes a normal chat. This can't be undone.

age_verification_required.title: You need to verify your age
age_verification_required.body: You can't use Sohby until you confirm that this account belongs to someone 18 or older. Upload a photo of an ID document below and our team will review it.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.body: Your account has been temporarily suspended for breaking the community rules.

closed.title: Your account has been permanently closed
closed.body: Your account was closed for a serious breach of the community rules. If you think this is a mistake, you can appeal.

deleted.title: You deleted your account
deleted.body: This account is closed. Your data will be permanently deleted after 90 days.

accountStatus.appealHint: Briefly explain why this should be reviewed again (at least 10 characters).
accountStatus.appealSent: Your appeal was received. We'll email you the outcome.
accountStatus.appealOpen: You have an open appeal; it's being reviewed.

errors.already_open: You already have an appeal under review.
errors.rate_limited: You've sent too many appeals. Please wait a few days.
errors.generic: Couldn't send the appeal. Please try again.

ageDoc.title: Upload an ID document
ageDoc.hint: A photo of an ID that shows your date of birth and your face (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB). You can cover other details such as your ID number.
ageDoc.privacy: Your document is encrypted and stored separately. Only our admins can see it, and every view is logged. It is deleted automatically after 30 days.
ageDoc.pending: We received your document and it's being reviewed. This screen will update once there's a decision.
ageDoc.rejected: The document you sent wasn't accepted. You can upload a new one.
ageDoc.expired: Your previous document expired before it was reviewed and has been deleted. Please upload it again.
ageDoc.otherHelp: Can't upload a document? Write to us:

location.citySearchHint: Start typing and pick from the list. For example Berlin, London, Amsterdam.

location.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# city found} other {# cities found}}

join.lead: A space only students can enter. Verify with your student ID and meet students on your campus.
join.benefit1: You only see verified students from your own university.
join.benefit2: A "Verified student" badge appears on your profile, so people know they are talking to a real student.
join.benefit3: Your card is stored encrypted, only our team sees it, and it is deleted within 7 days after review.
join.pendingBody: You sent your card on {date}. Campus opens once our team reviews it; this usually takes 1–2 days.
join.rejectedReason: Reason: {reason}. You can try again with a new photo.
join.expired: Your student verification has expired. Upload your current student ID to return to campus.
join.noUniversities: No university has campus open right now.
join.onlyStudents: Campus is only for enrolled students; graduates and staff cannot join. Verification is valid for 1 year.

form.title: Verify with your student ID
form.hint: Upload a clear photo of the front of your card. Our team checks and approves it.
form.universityHint: Campus is only open at this university for now. More universities are coming soon.
form.tips: Your name, photo and university name must be readable. If your card shows a national ID number, you can cover it. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
form.privacy: The photo is encrypted and stored separately; location and device data are removed. Only our team sees it and every view is logged. It is deleted within 7 days after review.

errors.not_allowed: You cannot upload a new card right now. You can renew 14 days before your verification ends.
errors.already_pending: Your previous card is still being reviewed.
